About.avatarAlt: Daniel Tapia - Senior Full Stack Developer

bio.intro: I’m a Senior Full Stack Developer with 7+ years building web products end to end, from the database and the API to the interface.
bio.current: I currently work at <highlight>SmartJob</highlight> for <highlight>Falabella Seller Center</highlight>, on the Promotions team. I take part in the team’s architecture decisions, lead a group of developers through the design and implementation of new features, and stay hands-on in the code. The promotions we build are used by sellers in Chile, Colombia and Peru.
bio.stack: My work covers the whole stack: React, Next.js and Angular on the client, including microfrontend architectures; Node.js with NestJS and Fastify, .NET 8, Java with Spring Boot and Python on the server; and PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL and Oracle for data. On FactuPro, an invoicing platform I build and operate, I also own the AWS infrastructure, defined in Terraform.
bio.leadership: On the leadership side, I decide with the team how features should be built, break initiatives into deliverables, review code and mentor developers.

falabella.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
falabella.summary: Promotions domain of Falabella Seller Center, used by marketplace sellers in Chile, Colombia and Peru.
highlights: Take part in architecture decisions for the team’s microfrontends and promotional flows, and lead a group of developers through the design and implementation of new features.
Build reusable React + TypeScript components for configuration-driven promotional workflows and seller dashboards.
Develop and maintain backend-for-frontend (BFF) services with Fastify that connect the React workflows with REST services, promotion metrics and authentication, with resilient error handling.
Work with product, design, QA and backend teams in an Agile setup, taking part in code reviews, release validation and technical decisions.

stafi.title: Full Stack Developer
stafi.summary: Stafi’s main platform, across the Next.js frontend and the NestJS backend.
highlights: Developed core features for staff task management modules and end-to-end documentation workflows.
Built frontend functionality with Next.js and TypeScript, focused on maintainability and user experience.
Implemented backend APIs and business logic with NestJS, with authentication and access control through Clerk.
Built and maintained database models and migrations with TypeORM on PostgreSQL for modules such as Escalations and Meetings.
Shipped production features on Vercel within an Agile, cross-functional team.

freelance-fullstack.title: Software Architect
freelance-fullstack.summary: Freelance architecture and full-stack work: the Armada Reserve fintech platform, automation and production web platforms.
highlights: Contributed to Armada Reserve, a fintech repo-trading platform for Armada Global LLC, working with Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Auth0, Kubernetes and Terraform.
Built n8n automation workflows that integrate Node.js services, CRMs, the WhatsApp API and Google Sheets to streamline lead management and client communication.
Configured AWS S3 and CloudFront, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, MySQL indexing, Redis caching, SSL, WAF and access controls for production web platforms.

axle.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
axle.summary: Platforms for U.S. research institutions, delivered through MushroomSoft for Axle Informatics.
highlights: NIH HITS: developed and optimized the system for the U.S. National Institutes of Health, supporting scientific research workflows.
Smart IRB: built the new version of the platform, used by leading U.S. research institutions, including Harvard University.
Delivered Angular and PrimeNG microfrontends and .NET 8 backend services on PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
Worked in a Scrum team with Azure DevOps and GitHub.

zeyo.title: Semi Senior Full Stack Developer
zeyo.summary: Blockchain-backed traceability systems for government and industry.
highlights: CERTERO: developed new features with Ecuador’s National Electoral Council, supporting vote traceability through a blockchain implementation.
Optimized data ingestion processes in Python and JavaScript to handle 800k+ records in under 6 hours.
Built and maintained the company’s Angular landing site, with AWS S3 for media storage and deployments automated through GitHub Actions and WP-CLI.
Safetrack: delivered the purchase order management and traceability/reporting modules for QR-based product labeling.

kengisoft.title: Junior Developer
highlights: Developed an electronic invoicing system with Node.js and Angular, including improvements to its payment integration.
Built a packing list system with Angular and Spring Boot to streamline logistics and integrate with inventory systems.
Contributed to an educational platform and delivered a WordPress marketing site with custom plugins and analytics dashboards.

freelance-web.title: Web Developer
freelance-web.summary: Web systems for Ecuadorian institutions and businesses.
highlights: Latacunga Fire Department: designed and implemented a payment management system and cleansed the institution’s deprecated database. That cleanup made it possible to recover more than USD 500,000 in overdue accounts, which the collections staff, such as cashiers, then collected gradually over about a year.
Empresa Eléctrica Ambato (EEASA): built traceability systems with Java Spring Boot, Angular and Oracle that improved incident visibility and response times.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.intro: Selected projects, each with its context, my role and what I worked on. Client work is described without confidential details.

armada-reserve.title: Armada Reserve - Repo Trading Desk (FinTech)
armada-reserve.role: Freelance · Armada Global LLC, through Latam Hire
armada-reserve.description: A platform for repurchase agreement (repo) trading desks that manages the full trade lifecycle, from entry and pre-trade compliance to settlement.
highlights: Delivered features across the Next.js trading desk and client portal and the NestJS API.
Those features included Auth0 MFA and step-up authentication, provider-aware settlement and wallet flows with digital-asset custody, and accounting records.
Hardened the Kubernetes infrastructure behind SOC 2 controls.

falabella-seller-center.title: Falabella Seller Center - Promotions
falabella-seller-center.role: SmartJob · Technical leadership and hands-on development
falabella-seller-center.description: The promotions area of Falabella Seller Center, used by sellers in Chile, Colombia and Peru, where promotional flows are configuration-driven to follow each country’s requirements.
highlights: Take part in architecture decisions for the team’s microfrontends and configuration-driven promotional flows, and lead a group of developers.
Build reusable React + TypeScript components for promotional workflows and seller dashboards.
Develop and maintain Fastify backend-for-frontend (BFF) services that connect those workflows with REST services, promotion metrics and authentication.
Work with product, design, QA and backend teams: code reviews, release validation and technical decisions.

eeasa-operations-logbook.title: EEASA - Electric Utility Operations Logbook
eeasa-operations-logbook.role: Freelance · Angular frontend and Spring Boot API
eeasa-operations-logbook.description: Operations logbook for Empresa Eléctrica Ambato (EEASA), an electric utility in central Ecuador. Control center and call center staff record faults, incidents, and operational events, manage work orders, and document field crew work with photos.
highlights: Worked on role-based access, operational dashboards, and Excel/PDF reports, including the reports for Ecuador’s national grid operator (CENACE).

nih-hits.title: NIH - HITS Platform (USA)
nih-hits.description: HITS is a platform at the U.S. National Institutes of Health (NIH) for exploring compound screening data, with table, gallery and plate views, keyword search, condition-based filters, and drug-combination synergy matrices.
highlights: Developed and optimized the system, working with Angular microfrontends and .NET 8 services on PostgreSQL.

smart-irb.title: Smart-IRB - New Version (Top U.S. Universities)
smart-irb.description: New version of Smart IRB, used by leading U.S. research institutions, including Harvard University.
highlights: Built the new version with Angular and PrimeNG microfrontends.
Delivered .NET 8 backend services on PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

certero.title: CERTERO - Vote Traceability (Blockchain)
certero.description: Blockchain-based system built with Ecuador’s National Electoral Council (CNE) to support vote traceability.
highlights: Developed new features for the system at Zeyo, working with cross-functional teams.

safetrack.title: Safetrack - QR Labeling & Traceability
safetrack.description: A traceability solution for product labeling and authenticity verification, using QR codes and blockchain-backed records.
highlights: Delivered the purchase order management module.
Delivered traceability and reporting features.

factupro-v2.title: FactuPro v2 - Cloud Invoicing Platform (Web, Mobile & AWS)
factupro-v2.role: I build and operate it end to end
factupro-v2.description: Second generation of FactuPro, an electronic invoicing platform for businesses in Ecuador. A new Next.js web client and a React Native (Expo) mobile app share the Express API and add modules such as restaurant table and order management.
highlights: Moved the platform from Heroku to AWS, with the infrastructure defined in Terraform.
Docker containers on an ARM64 EC2 instance, with database migrations on every deploy.
Deployment pipelines with GitHub OIDC.
Signing certificates stored encrypted, with the key held in AWS SSM.

factupro-v1.title: FactuPro v1 - Electronic Invoicing System (Ecuador SRI)
factupro-v1.description: First version of FactuPro, in production since 2020 for several companies.
highlights: Angular frontend and Node.js/Express API that generate electronic invoices, sign them with XAdES-BES, and send them to Ecuador’s tax authority (SRI).
Builds the PDF invoice and emails it to the customer.
Payment integration, sales reports, and Excel/PDF exports.

weather-app.title: Weather App - Real-Time Forecast
weather-app.description: This is a sample Angular project that demonstrates how to use the OpenWeather and VisualCrossing APIs to create an admin panel and a daily weather visualization.

portfolio-v2.title: Personal Portfolio - 2026 (Version 2)
portfolio-v2.description: Second iteration of my personal portfolio, built with Next.js and modern frontend tooling. Focused on clean UI, performance, SEO, and clear presentation of professional experience and real-world projects.

portfolio-v1.title: Personal Portfolio - 2020 (Version 1)
portfolio-v1.description: First version of my personal portfolio, developed as an early-career project. It showcases my initial work in frontend development and marks the starting point of my professional growth as a software developer.

clinical-records-backend.title: Clinical Records Backend - Municipal Health Center (Thesis Project)
clinical-records-backend.description: Backend system for managing clinical histories, developed as my university thesis for the Municipal Patronage of Latacunga. Designed to handle patient records, medical consultations, and secure data access for healthcare personnel.
